name: The cliff
blurb: The heavy edge is a cliff. This one makes you go around.
aside: E8 and E7 share a side, and that side is the cliff. The walk around scores −9. The ball at E9 is two steps off E8. That walk scores −8, and it is the best line. The stick at A7 is two steps off the start. Two steps for one stick loses, and that walk scores −10.
